changes.reason: Source instructs not to assume the lost-card response is complete because the old card remains, rather than not to complete the response.

changes.after: 我会看下面一行。即使没有显示变更通知，也不能说肯定在那个时刻到达，对吗？
changes.reason: 登出 commonly means log out; source refers to no change notice being displayed.

changes.before: 我會看下面一列。即使沒登出變更通知，也不能說肯定在那個時刻到達，對嗎？
changes.after: 我會看下面一列。即使沒有顯示變更通知，也不能說肯定在那個時刻到達，對嗎？

changes.before: ពន្យល់ថាយឺតនៅជួរលើទៅសមុទ្រ និងម៉ោងដូចគ្នាធ្វើឱ្យស្មានថាជើងខ្លួន។ សូមនិយាយជាភាសាជប៉ុន។
changes.after: ពន្យល់ថាយឺតនៅជួរលើទៅសមុទ្រ និងម៉ោងប្រហាក់ប្រហែលធ្វើឱ្យស្មានថាជើងខ្លួន។ សូមនិយាយជាភាសាជប៉ុន។
changes.reason: Source says similar times, not identical times.

changes.before: ရလာတဲ့စာရွက်အဓိပ္ပာယ်တိုင်ပင်ချင်တယ်။ ဂျပန်ရှင်းပြချက်ကိုသူငယ်ချင်းကကူနားလည်ပေးချင်လို့အတူလာလို့ရလားသိချင်တယ်။
changes.after: ရလာတဲ့စာရွက်တွေရဲ့အဓိပ္ပာယ်ကို တိုင်ပင်ချင်ပါတယ်။ ဂျပန်လိုရှင်းပြတာကို နားလည်ဖို့ သူငယ်ချင်းဆီက အကူအညီယူချင်လို့ အတူလာလို့ရမရ သိချင်ပါတယ်။
changes.reason: Source states the player wants help from a friend understanding Japanese explanation, not that the friend wants to help.

changes.before: Naiba ninyo bago makopya. May hindi ba mabasang salita sa petsa at oras ng ikalawang papel?
changes.after: Napag-iba ninyo ang dalawa bago makopya. May hindi ba mabasang salita sa petsa at oras ng ikalawang papel?
changes.reason: Source praises distinguishing the two documents before copying; Naiba means changed/different rather than distinguished.

changes.before: တာဝန်ခံစစ်မယ်။ မှတ်တမ်းထဲဧည့်လက်ခံချိန်ရေးပြီးဆေးစစ်စချိန်လို့မရေးသေးဘူး။

changes.reason: Source asks/checks with responsible staff; original compressed wording could mean checking the staff member.

changes.before: Hiniram pala. Pareho ba ang huling lugar na nakita ninyo sa kamera at ang lugar na binuksan ang bag para isauli?
changes.after: Hiniram pala. Pareho ba ang lugar kung saan ninyo huling nakita ang kamera at ang lugar kung saan ninyo binuksan ang bag para isauli ito?
changes.reason: Use camera as the object seen; original sa kamera could mean seen on/in the camera.

changes.before: Hiwalay nating itala ang huling pinagkitaan at pinagpansinan. May maipapaliwanag ba kayong modelo, kulay, o katangian?
changes.after: Hiwalay nating itala ang lugar kung saan huling nakita ang kamera at ang lugar kung saan napansing nawawala ito. May maipapaliwanag ba kayong modelo, kulay, o katangian?
changes.reason: Make the two distinct locations explicit; original pinagkitaan is normally a place of earnings rather than last-seen location.

changes.before: नहीं। आखिरी बार दोपहर की बैठी बेंच पर देखा था, और घर लौटकर पता चला कि नहीं है।
changes.after: नहीं। आखिरी बार उसे उस बेंच पर देखा था जहाँ मैं दोपहर में बैठा था, और घर लौटने के बाद पता चला कि वह नहीं है।
changes.reason: Source says the player sat on the bench at midday; original clause grammatically attaches sitting to the bench.

changes.before: 這是昨天買的摺疊傘。打開後無法固定，會自己合起來。我想先請人看過，再決定是否要用力推。

changes.reason: Source only says seeking inspection before pushing hard; does not add a decision afterward whether to push hard.

changes.before: रसिद र झोला भएको, एकपटक खोलेको, नखोलेर मर्मत नगरेको बताउनुहोस्। जापानीमा भन्नुहोस्।

changes.reason: Source distinguishes opening the umbrella once from not dismantling/repairing it; original नखोलेर could contradict opening once.

changes.before: तालाब से पश्चिम निकास की रेखा पर चलकर देखिए। पूर्व निकास के पास वाले रास्ते से अलग होने पर संकेत है।

Sold-out dish replacement: cancellation mark versus duplicate charge, verify drinks, pay jointly then split privately, request itemized evidence.
Goshuin after worship: application and collection queues, hear verification/calling instructions before leaving, keep companion from leaving early, avoid blocking others.
Castle reconstruction illustration is estimated former appearance, not current building photo; retain heading, distinguish site evidence and follow photo/footing instructions.
Tired companion: shorten walk, do not infer accessible paths from map alone, rest without obstruction, return to entrance at companions pace and assess rain/slipperiness.
Two takeaway drinks: personal container for hot drink only, store authorization pending, joint name collection and accurate handoff.
Father hearing difficulty: ask for written explanations without guarantee, separate exhibits/events and opening date information.
Bathing area: separate clothing, identify secure key attachment using actual shape and read rules before entry.
Family hotel booking: meal plan says no meals, breakfast addition and conditions unconfirmed, consult family before applying.
Rain-faded work boundary: remain at safe checking point, do not move tools in, get current boundaries and routes then repeat back.

Repair-device shipping: specify battery and device details, manual photograph and uncertain removability, do not remove while unsure, domestic versus overseas destination unconfirmed, temporarily closed box remains unsealed until checks, contents and packing conditions before shipment.
